title: Mårék's Known Region

current_position.state: first light; ready to depart toward the reported Dāren Ford lead

authority.source: Dropbox LIVE campaign masters plus explicit live user geography corrections and CP97

coordinate_model.warning: Coordinates are renderer placement aids only. They are not canonical measurements unless the feature's spatial_basis says locked.

features.name: Kareth
known_facts: Current base settlement
Sits on an open shelf / natural terrace, not a tight valley or basin
The former new front defensive line is now a substantial outer wall; the old wall remains as an inner defensive line
Kareth has exactly two gates: the front/main gate and the back/quarry gate
The front gate serves Avelin and most outward regional travel
The back gate serves the quarry and haul road

features.name: Kareth Quarry
known_facts: Cut within broader stony upland / broken higher ground
Going up toward the quarry is slower; returning toward Kareth is faster
Quarry is viable and active
Heavy blocks are stockpiled
The Kareth–Quarry route is a regularly used worked haul road with major hazards reduced and drainage improved
Dark low-bodied creature threat was unresolved before Mårék's 337-day absence; current status has not yet been checked

features.name: Avelin
known_facts: Avelin relocated to the former cairn-marked candidate site during Mårék's 337-day absence
Avelin remains a separate settlement with its own wall, people, leadership, fields, and livestock
Kareth and Avelin are close neighbors rather than one merged settlement
The groundwater seep has been developed into a proper stone-edged collection point
The Kareth–Avelin alliance held through the absence
A maintained road connects Kareth's front gate with Avelin

features.name: Valek road split
known_facts: Before Saddle Ridge, the road to Valek splits from the northeast main road
The Valek road turns north from the split
Exact location along the road remains schematic
No additional proper right-hand road branch was observed here from the Kareth-facing approach
No readable informational signpost was observed here

features.name: Saddle Ridge
known_facts: Avelin now lies on the Kareth-facing side of the broader Saddle Ridge corridor
Rolling hills build gradually toward Saddle Ridge
The old Avelin site lies farther along the established road beyond the ridge corridor

features.name: Old Avelin Site
known_facts: Former/original Avelin settlement site beyond Saddle Ridge
Old wall remains in substantial sections
House and structure shapes remain
No obvious bustle or visible roof smoke was seen from the road during Mårék's visit
Some building materials have been removed from parts of the site
The site has not been flattened
The old road runs into the former settlement
Current occupancy, ownership, and exact use remain unresolved

features.name: Low Ridge
known_facts: First established landmark on the Kareth–Valek route
No carved roadside marker exists here

features.name: Stone-bottomed Stream Crossing
known_facts: Shallow, firm stone-bottomed crossing
Traveler-use signs established
Broad shade trees downstream established
Far bank has a small natural runoff channel a few feet across at widest
Runoff channel showed little/no flow during the recent visit, with erosion, darker staining and washed gravel from prior stronger water
No clear foot trail, wagon marks, worked stone, marker, or structure was observed in the runoff channel

features.name: Valek

travel.time: ~7 hours to Kareth at established pace

known_facts: Established substantial road town
Reached by the road that branches north before Saddle Ridge
Exact direct compass bearing from Kareth remains unresolved
Busy stable yard, active tavern and market observed
An internal town street junction was observed but is not established as a regional outbound route split
No additional proper crossroads or readable directional road signs were observed on Mårék's current Kareth-to-Valek ride

terrain_zones.name: Kareth shelf
terrain_zones.description: Relatively level usable ground; not a tight valley or enclosed basin

terrain_zones.name: Southwest stony upland
terrain_zones.description: Ground becomes progressively rockier and more elevated toward the quarry

terrain_zones.name: Northeast rolling corridor
terrain_zones.description: Avelin occupies the near portion; low rolling hills become more pronounced toward Saddle Ridge and the old Avelin route continues beyond

placed_routes.name: Kareth front road / Avelin–Saddle Ridge corridor
notes: Leaves Kareth through the front/main gate
Avelin is the first major settlement on this northeast route
The Kareth–Avelin section is maintained and well traveled
The Valek road branches north before Saddle Ridge
No other proper branch was found during Mårék's deliberate search of this corridor

placed_routes.name: Saddle Ridge–Old Avelin road
notes: The old road continues to the former Avelin site
Mårék deliberately checked for right-hand branches outbound and left-hand branches returning; none were found

placed_routes.name: Kareth–Valek road
notes: Branches north from the northeast main road before Saddle Ridge
Known route order: Low Ridge, Stone-bottomed Stream Crossing, Valek
Kareth to Valek is ~4.5 hours by horseback / Drāvek
Valek to Kareth loaded heavy caravan is ~7 hours at the established pace
No additional proper crossroads or informational road signs were observed on the current ride

placed_routes.name: Kareth–Quarry haul road
notes: Leaves Kareth through the back/quarry gate
~45 minutes loaded handcart with ~15 minutes variation by grade
Regular use and improvements have made it a worked haul road

known_unplaced.name: Dāren Ford

reported_relation.source: Tovan and Brask; secondhand road/caravan talk

reported_facts: Described as a road place with traders, ferries, and inns
Road described as safe enough usually
A months-old rumor says a bright light was seen at night and one living person with strange clothes and strange speech was found by morning
The found person's sex varies in retellings
Neither Tovan nor Brask witnessed the event
The rumor is not proof of an off-world arrival or of the woman from the Black
